name: spec-flow
description: Run the PRD -> TRD -> issue planning pipeline: decompose a product spec into per-component TRDs, TRDs into Epic/Feature/Task issues, and reverse-engineer finished work back into specs and prompts.

interface.shortDescription: Turn a product spec into technical designs, then into issues
interface.longDescription: Spec Flow bundles the five skills that carry a product spec down to filed work and back again: prd-to-trd splits one PRD into per-component TRD scaffolds, trd-to-issues decomposes a filled-in TRD into Epic/Feature/Task and bulk-creates GitHub milestones and issues (only with --apply; the default is a reviewable dry-run plan), pr-to-ssot-issue reverse-engineers an exception PR that skipped PRD/TRD into an SSOT tracking issue, reverse-engineering-analysis turns an existing feature into a copy-pasteable AI implementation prompt, and claude-to-codex rewrites a Claude-authored phase document into an imperative doc a Codex run can execute from alone.
defaultPrompt: Decompose this PRD into per-component TRDs.
Turn this TRD into milestones and issues.
